title: Valgrind memcheck
description: The classic binary-instrumentation leak checker; reports definitely/indirectly/possibly lost blocks at exit. It finds heap leaks by binary instrumentation of malloc/free. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: LeakSanitizer
description: Compile with -fsanitize=leak for near-zero-overhead leak reports at process exit. It finds heap leaks by compiler-inserted allocation tracking. Platform: Linux, macOS.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: AddressSanitizer
description: Catches use-after-free and overflows at runtime, which are leaks’ close cousins. It finds memory errors by shadow-memory instrumentation. Platform: Linux, macOS, Windows.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Go pprof heap
description: net/http/pprof exposes heap profiles; go tool pprof diffs two snapshots to find growth. It finds Go heap growth by sampling heap profiler. Platform: any Go runtime.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: jemalloc profiling
description: MALLOC_CONF=prof:true dumps allocation sites; jeprof attributes retained bytes to call stacks. It finds native heap retention by sampling allocator profiler. Platform: Linux, macOS, BSD.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Chrome heap snapshots
description: DevTools heap snapshots with the comparison view reveal detached DOM trees and growing closures. It finds JS heap leaks by heap snapshot diffing. Platform: Chrome/Edge.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: VisualVM sampler
description: The free JDK-bundled profiler sampling heap and threads to spot runaway object retention. It finds Java heap leaks by heap dump + sampler. Platform: any JDK.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: lsof for fd leaks
description: lsof -p lists a process’s open files; a count climbing forever means descriptor leaks. It finds fd leaks by inspecting open file tables. Platform: Linux, macOS, BSD.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: /proc fd inspection
description: Counting entries in /proc/<pid>/fd over time is the zero-tool way to catch descriptor leaks. It finds fd leaks by kernel-exposed fd counts. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: eBPF memleak
description: bpftrace’s memleak.bt traces kmalloc/kfree in the kernel to find unbalanced allocations. It finds kernel leaks by eBPF tracepoints on alloc/free. Platform: Linux 4.9+.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: tracemalloc
description: Python’s tracemalloc attributes every allocation to a traceback; compare snapshots to find growth. It finds Python leaks by allocation traceback tracking. Platform: any Python 3.4+.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: dotnet counters
description: dotnet-counters watches GC heap size and gen collections live without a full profiler. It finds .NET heap growth by EventPipe runtime counters. Platform: .NET Core.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Handle count on Windows
description: Task Manager’s Handles column or handle.exe exposes GDI/USER handle leaks in Win32 apps. It finds Windows handle leaks by handle table enumeration. Platform: Windows.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: massif heap profiler
description: Valgrind’s massif draws heap usage over time so spikes map to program phases. It finds heap usage over time by allocation-time profiling. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Xcode Leaks instrument
description: Instruments’ Leaks template finds malloc blocks with no reachable references in iOS/macOS apps. It finds ObjC/Swift leaks by reference-graph analysis. Platform: macOS, iOS.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
